items.title: DGP on YelpChi: build graph, check edge count against Table 1, then 5 seeds
items.detail: DGP 61.76 / 78.38 / 31.05 (paper 69.07 / 84.28 / 48.87); MLP 63.64 / 74.66 / 33.67 (paper 62.09 / 75.00 / 32.24). DGP - MLP: AUROC +3.72 (5/5, Holm p 0.004), AUPRC -2.62 (0/5, Holm p 0.039). Early stopping on val loss keeps epoch 1-3 while val AUROC peaks at the last epoch in every seed: a hyperparameter-search item. results/controls/yelpchi.md, README §11, E16.

items.title: Ablation: w/o MDK (random neighbours)
items.detail: R0 with mdk: false (M=4 random neighbours, controls/A1_without_mdk.yaml), 5 seeds, training 14:42-20:11Z. noMDK 65.28 / 74.61 / 32.51 vs R0 64.74 / 74.97 / 32.37 (Macro-F1 / AUROC / AUPRC). R0 - noMDK: -0.53 / +0.36 / -0.14, none significant (bootstrap CIs include 0): MDK adds nothing measurable; the paper reports a decline. results/controls/nomdk.md; README §14; report E17 card.

items.title: Fourth cell: Qwen text + Gemma classifier
items.detail: QG0 = R0's Qwen text + Gemma-2-9B-it classifier, 5 seeds (20:25Z 11-02 -> 04:00Z 11-03, all rc 0, 1.5 h/run alone, 27.5 GB). QG0 64.70 / 76.18 / 33.74. Gemma as classifier: +1.21 AUROC / +1.37 AUPRC on Qwen's text (5/5 seeds, CIs above 0), +1.02 / +1.44 on Gemma's text. Gemma's text: +0.20 / +0.57 with Gemma classifier, +0.39 / +0.49 with Qwen (CIs include 0). Interaction -0.19 AUROC (p 0.43), +0.08 AUPRC (p 0.89): the roles add up. results/gemma_swap/exp4_2x2.md; E18.

items.title: Hyperparameter search: epoch-selection rule (E19) + YelpChi lr sweep (E20)
items.detail: Owner decision 2026-11-03: S1 (epoch-selection rule, both datasets, 5 seeds) + S2-Y (YelpChi lr 1e-5 and 3e-5 at rank 8, 2 seeds); rank grid, confirmation and M sweep not run. Log mining of all 178 runs: on YelpChi the best-val-AUROC epoch was never kept (+4.02 val AUROC / +6.67 AUPRC), on AmazonVideo +0.4. Every run trains 10 epochs; test scored at each rule's epoch. 14 runs, ~67 GPU-h, queue scripts/sel_queue.sh started 07:13Z 11-03, expected finish ~11-05. research/hparam_search_plan.md, README §23.
